subject: design-technology
title: Layout & Colour
welcome_lead: Grids, whitespace and colour for graphics.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: layout grids, whitespace, colour in design.
final_note: A clear layout earns the reader's attention.

concepts.def: How elements arrange on a page.

walkthroughs.body_html: Designers split the page into invisible columns — a grid. Aligning elements to the grid makes everything feel tidy and intentional, like a magazine page.
Whitespace isn't wasted — it gives the eye places to rest and makes important parts stand out. Cluttered designs lose readers.
A colour palette for graphics usually has 2-4 colours: a main, a contrast, and maybe accent. Stick to it across all pages for a consistent brand feel.
